text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Aoi Stakes, and I'm
worried
about how busy Каррен Тян has
been posting on
all of her social media.
What if it affects her
performance
today?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Каррен Тян cutely declares
that her
performance will take all of my
worries away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
